item.title: Video: Watch Patti LuPone Yodel in PALM ROYALE Sneak Peek Clip
item.description: Ahead of its debut on Wednesday, December 10, Apple has shared a new sneak peek clip of Tony Award winner Patti LuPone in the new episode of Palm Royale. In the clip, the Broadway icon guest stars as renowned businesswoman Marjorie Merriweather Post, who shows off her yodeling skills during a square-dance party in Palm Beach. item.title: Video: John McCook Looks Back at Broadway Start in WEST SIDE STORY Revival
item.description: John McCook wasn't always known as Eric Forrester on The Bold and the Beautiful. A longtime veteran of the popular CBS soap opera, McCook got his start on Broadway in a 1964 City Center revival of West Side Story immediately after arriving in New York. During an appearance on CBS's Soapy podcast, the performer shared his short-lived Broadway experience and how it led to his long career in Hollywood. item.description: The Queen of Versailles, which previously announced its closing date as January 4, 2026, will now close at Broadway's St. James Theatre two weeks earlier, on Sunday, December 21.
